description.text: German Accelerator empowers top German startups to grow beyond borders by providing access to international markets, expert mentorship, and industry connections.

targetApplicants.text: "When it comes to choosing a startup accelerator for international expansion, Kellermann is clear: “In my opinion, I highly recommend German Accelerator,” he said."
